verdict: Spend surged but leads fell — efficiency is the focus right now.
narrative: This period, your cost per lead spiked 165% week-over-week while leads actually declined 12.5%, meaning the sharp rise in Google Ads spend did not translate into additional inquiries. The Local Services campaign alone consumed $435.55 of that Google budget, yet in-platform conversions across all of Google totaled just 9 over the full 28 days. Separately, nine agreed-upon setup milestones — including heating campaign launches and booking automation — remain overdue, and those items are the gate that must clear before any budget scale-up makes sense. We're auditing the Google campaign pacing now and pressing to close the overdue milestones so the account is ready to capture heating-season demand.

highlights.phrase: average cost per lead this period, up sharply from the prior week
leads tracked in-platform over the last 28 days
setup milestones past due, including heating campaigns and booking automation

watch_item.issue: Google Ads spend jumped 439% week-over-week with no corresponding increase in leads, signaling the budget is not converting efficiently.
watch_item.fix: Campaign pacing is being reviewed and tightened this week; heating-season campaigns will not receive additional budget until the efficiency issue is resolved and overdue milestones are closed.
